segments.he: אִם מִשֶּׁנִּשְׁחַט נוֹדַע כּוּ׳. קָתָנֵי: הַבָּשָׂר יֵצֵא לְבֵית הַשְּׂרֵפָה. אַלְמָא: חוּלִּין שֶׁנִּשְׁחֲטוּ בַּעֲזָרָה – בִּשְׂרֵיפָה.
segments.en: § With regard to one who brought a provisional guilt offering and «after» the ram «was slaughtered it became known» to him that he did not sin, the mishna «teaches: The flesh shall go out to the place of burning. Evidently,» according to the opinion of the tanna of the mishna, «non-sacred animals that were slaughtered in the» Temple «courtyard,» such as this provisional guilt offering that was mistakenly consecrated, are «to» be «burned.»
